title: 有馬記念の後に・努力より尊いもの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Writing her own legend as she goes, Mejiro Ryan surpasses the superstar Oguri Cap and claims victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In her post-race interview, she declares that her glorious victory is all thanks to her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the wake of her defeat, Oguri Cap's captivation with Mejiro Ryan's racing leads her to tell Ryan that she wants to continue racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan has grown so much that she's begun to charm even the superstar racers.
